answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent grows one willow of attested tasks over time, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake, so a thousand copies cost a thousand verified crossings instead of one free signup. An onyx record of who vouched for whom lets peers trace a puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once, and a lantern ledger makes every endorsement visible before any vote counts.
